type.description: What the page is; one of the types below.

description.description: One sentence an agent reads to decide whether to open the page; it becomes the index line.

generated.description: Who last changed the page, its body or its properties, and when.

resource.description: The file or URL the page is about: contents/<mount>/<path>, or a URL.

sources.description: What the page was made from: pages, files in contents/, or URLs.

verified.description: Who confirmed the page, and when; the review that shares it.

stale_after.description: When a time-bound claim must be re-checked.

tags.description: Free labels; offered from the tags already in use.

sensitivity.description: Input to promotion, not access control.

relations.description: Typed edges to other pages or URLs; the graph index draws them.

journal.description: A dated record a person wrote: a day, a meeting or a week.
journal.heading: # Entries

concept.description: One reusable claim, pattern or explanation, including an answer filed back so it is not re-derived.
concept.heading: # Concepts

decision.description: What was decided, why, and what was rejected.
decision.heading: # Decisions

policy.description: A rule or standard the scope holds.
policy.heading: # Policies

reference.description: What a file someone else wrote says, and where it matters.
reference.heading: # References

artifact.description: A deliverable we made: what it is, what it was made from, what was decided.
artifact.heading: # Artifacts

org.description: The record of an organization or team.
org.heading: # Organizations

about.description: The person, organization or project this page is about; the graph gathers pages around those records.

part_of.description: This person, organization or project belongs to the organization or project the target records.

uses.description: What this page describes depends on or applies what the target describes; what the page was written from belongs in sources.

same_as.description: The same identity, whose record a higher scope owns.
